model: same model inherited from parent; exact backend ID/revision not exposed by collaboration tool
isolation: one fork_turns=none agent per attempt; separate candidate; explicit no reading peers, grader or references; control explicitly excludes deno-to-bun skill
order: case order fixed; first arm alternates by case and repeat; up to three overlapping attempts
cache: shared runtime/package caches; evaluator selftest warms required packages before all attempts; fresh-dependency acceptance snapshots
acceptance: existing evals/run.py, unchanged; each final submission frozen before independent grading; no repairs
review: parent reviews final diffs and handoffs; reviewer is aware of arm (not blinded)
metrics: agent-recorded elapsed seconds; unavailable token usage/cost remain null; no manual repairs
limitations: Agents share a host and tool/skill catalog; filesystem access restrictions are instructions, not OS isolation
Same base model but backend identity/seed unavailable
